title: Carney, at a Cabinet Retreat, Considers Further Trade Strikes Against the U.S.
summary_full: Canada’s retaliation this week against President Trump’s tariffs was met with more American tariffs and a closed U.S. border on some Canadian products.
summary_public: Canada’s retaliation this week against President Trump’s tariffs was met with more American tariffs and a closed U.S. border on some Canadian products.
